github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Follow Conventional Commits as described in .gitmessage. The first line is `<type>(<scope>): <short summary>`: a type from the list, an optional scope, then a lowercase summary in the imperative mood with no full stop, 72 characters at most. Leave a blank line, then a body that explains why the change was needed and what it does, wrapped at 72 characters. Don't output the placeholder lines or the comment lines from the template.
